title: [main] Bug 657281 [Drop Shipment] Your Reference, , Vendor Order No., and Vendor Shipment No. are blank on Posted Purchase Receipt Lines
summary: Drop shipment receipts now correctly populate Your Reference, Vendor Order No., and Vendor Shipment No. fields on posted purchase receipt lines when automatically posted from sales orders.
key_points: Fixes blank Your Reference, Vendor Order No. and Vendor Shipment No. on posted purchase receipt lines for drop shipments
Applies when the purchase receipt is posted automatically from the sales order
Changes Purch.-Post and Sales-Post in W1 and several country layers
Adds tests in the SCM orders test codeunit (W1 and IT)
